title: Quick feedback needed - What do you think of this update visualization ? Play action pass for a touchdown ...
author: protheus99

comments.author: protheus99
comments.body:
responding to the comment about how ai fits into this development:

I have worked only with Ai through the whole development cycle for this project.   
Gemini was the core of the project initially, at work i get tons of credits with Gemini-4-argon and I used that to define the base project scope.  
I used ChatGPT for some reasoning tasks at the beginning but i didn't really like where it was going, I switched to Claude afterwards and have stuck with it since.

For this specific task, I defined a process to build out the visuals for a play.  
the initial design was absolutely terrible, the players were moving in a "wooden" way and just not doing anything. I then worked through how do make movement more reaslistic but trying to understand what happens during a play, it's a lot of movement and shift that make it look natural, so i asked that this be added too, instead of players getting set and then stopping, they never really stopped.

I modeled myself after some of the NFL next gen stats views, one thing that was very important there was showing that no one moves in a straight line, everyone curves and changes course throughout each of their routes, the linemen aren't just blocking they are moving too.

I don't want to go too far here on the details but let's say it took a while to get it right.

Anyone needing more detail let me know ...
